settings.subtitle: Haida is a high-volume Chinese tire brand we stock for value-conscious Calgary drivers — 216 active SKUs across sedan and SUV sizes. We carry the HD617 (all-season), EX-COMFORT (touring), and additional sizes for older vehicles and third cars at 111 42 Ave SW.
settings.intro_heading: Why we recommend Haida in Calgary
settings.intro_richtext:
Haida is a Chinese tire manufacturer producing high volumes of DOT-certified passenger and light-truck tires. We stock 216 active Haida SKUs — primarily for value-conscious Calgary drivers, fleet operators, and older-vehicle owners where premium tread life isn't worth the markup.

The HD617 is the most-installed Haida in our shop — a quiet, M+S-rated all-season for daily sedan and crossover commuting. The EX-COMFORT is the touring-comfort variant with a quieter ride profile.

Important: Haida is not a winter or all-weather brand — we don't recommend Haida for primary winter use. Pair them with a dedicated winter tire from Michelin, Bridgestone, or even Radar's Dimax 4SEASON for the cold months. For April-October daily driving on dry and wet Calgary pavement, they hold up.

Every Haida we install gets the same balance, calibrated torque, and TPMS reset as our premium-priced jobs — and we price-match local Calgary competitors. Book installation or call (403) 452-4283.
settings.cta_description: Stocked Haida sizes installed same-day. Same balance and torque standards as our premium installs.
settings.faq_1_q: Is Haida a good tire brand?
settings.faq_1_a: Haida is a budget-tier Chinese brand — built to DOT and international safety standards, but not in the same engineering league as premium or premium-adjacent brands. Best fit for value-conscious drivers, older vehicles, and high-mileage drivers where premium tread life isn't worth the markup.
settings.faq_2_q: How much do Haida tires cost in Calgary?
settings.faq_2_a: Haida tires at Prince Tires range from $80 to $160 per tire — about 50-70% less than premium-tier equivalents. HD617 starts around $86 in 16" sizes; EX-COMFORT around $90 in 15" sizes.
settings.faq_3_q: Should I use Haida tires in Calgary winters?
settings.faq_3_a: We don't recommend Haida as a primary winter tire. They're M+S-rated but lack the 3PMSF (three-peak mountain snowflake) certification required by Alberta's winter-tire law. For winter, pair with dedicated winter tires from Michelin, Bridgestone, or even budget-tier Radar Dimax 4SEASON (3PMSF rated).
settings.faq_4_q: When does Haida make sense for a Calgary driver?
settings.faq_4_a: Haida makes sense for: older vehicles (10+ years), third cars and seasonal vehicles, high-mileage commuters who replace tires frequently anyway, fleet operators on a strict budget, and anyone who already has a separate winter set and just needs basic summer pavement tires.
settings.faq_5_q: Can I get same-day Haida install in Calgary?
settings.faq_5_a: Yes for most stocked sizes — Haida has deep inventory at our shop. HD617 and EX-COMFORT in common 14-17" sedan sizes are reliably in stock. Call (403) 452-4283 to confirm.
settings.faq_6_a: Haida tires carry a basic manufacturer defect warranty (no specific treadwear km warranty on most models — industry standard for budget-tier brands). Prince Tires processes any warranty claims directly with the importer on behalf of customers.
settings.calgary_richtext: Haida is what we install on third-car drivers, older daily commuters, or anyone who's genuinely on a budget. HD921 is our most-common Haida winter; HD927 covers all-season passenger sedans. Same install, balance, torque, and TPMS reset as any premium tire on the floor — we never cut corners based on what you paid.
